# Mental Health UK

> > Mental Health UK provides mental health support, workplace wellbeing programs, and resources through initiatives like Bloom, Your Resilience, Mental Health & Money Advice, and partnerships with organizations including Lloyds Banking Group and Innovation Broking.

Mental Health UK is a national charity offering mental health services, workplace training, and support programs across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. The organization operates through family charities including Rethink Mental Illness and Adferiad, delivering services like Into Work employment support and Balance peer support networks.

## Key Topics

- Workplace wellbeing and mental health training
- Burnout prevention and awareness
- Your Resilience program
- Bloom youth mental health resources
- Mental Health & Money Advice service
- Peer support networks
- Personal recovery stories and lived experience
- Body image and self-perception
- Suicide bereavement support
- Workplace mental health conversations
- Fundraising and community engagement
- Partnership collaborations
- Into Work employment support
- Mental health awareness campaigns
- Balance support services

## Mental Health Information & Resources

- [Talking about mental health at work](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/help-and-information/talking-about-mental-health-at-work): Guide for approaching workplace mental health conversations with colleagues
- [Bloom Resource Library](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/help-and-information/advice-for-parents-and-guardians/bloom-resource-library): Bloom resources for parents on youth mental health and resilience

## Get Involved & Fundraising

- [Local Runs](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/get-involved/local-runs): Find local running events across UK regions to fundraise for Mental Health UK
- [Great Wall of China Trek 2026](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/get-involved/events/great-wall-of-china-trek): 9-day Great Wall of China trek fundraising challenge for 2026
- [Expression of interest](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/get-involved/expression-of-interest): Form to share lived experience stories and volunteer with Mental Health UK

## Personal Stories & Lived Experience

- [My experience with anxiety and PTSD from suicide bereavement](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/my-experience-with-anxiety-and-ptsd-from-suicide-bereavement): Damien's personal story managing PTSD and anxiety after suicide bereavement
- [Don't wait until you become too unwell](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/dont-wait-until-you-become-too-unwell): Murat's personal story about burnout and eating disorder experiences
- [Navigating a negative body image](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/navigating-a-negative-body-image): Explores body image issues and Rebecca's experience with body negativity
- [How opening up about my mental health helped me overcome my negative perception of my appearance](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/how-opening-up-about-my-mental-health-helped-me-overcome-my-negative-perception-of-my-appearance): Christian's journey overcoming body image issues from facial differences
- [Why leaving teaching was the best thing for my mental health](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/why-leaving-teaching-was-the-best-thing-for-my-mental-health): Michael's story about teacher burnout and career change for mental health
- [Mo's Story](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/about-us/stories/mos-story): Mo's recovery journey with Change Mental Health in Dumfries

- [Mental Health UK welcomes Olympian Michelle Griffith-Robinson as new trustee](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/mental-health-uk-welcomes-olympian-michelle-griffith-robinson-as-new-trustee): Olympian Michelle Griffith-Robinson joins Mental Health UK board of trustees
- ['Walk and talk' men's group is helping men to open up about mental health](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/walk-and-talk-mens-group-is-helping-men-to-open-up-about-mental-health): Bank of America Chester walking group helps men discuss mental health
- [Your Resilience: improving mental health at Newcastle Eagles](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/your-resilience-improving-mental-health-at-newcastle-eagles): Your Resilience program supports mental health for Newcastle Eagles players
- [Mental Health UK team up with Innovation Broking](https://mentalhealth-uk.org/blog/mental-health-uk-team-up-with-innovation-broking): Partnership announcement with Innovation Broking for workplace mental health
